Nightfall Outpost (Windows)

Double-click NightfallOutpost.exe to play. Nothing to install.

If Windows says Smart App Control blocked it, play in your browser
instead: https://reesegodwin.github.io/zombie_defence/

The first time, Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the game
isn't signed by a known publisher. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

Your Grit, camp upgrades and settings are saved in
%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Nightfall Outpost

How to play: WASD walks (the camera follows you), the left mouse button
shoots where you aim. Click the workbench in the yard for the Workshop and
the drafting table for Research. Click a survivor, then a spot, to move them;
click them again to repair the wall there.

Keys: R reload, I storage, B workshop, T research, M scavenge, C camp,
P pause, O options, N sound. F5 quick save, F9 quick load (it also autosaves
every dawn).

Co-op: from the title screen, host a game or join a friend's by address.
